guidance.statement: We're on track on our guidance for March of 3,000 stores.

status_history.evidence: Store target raised to 3,500 by March 2027 from 3,000; 2,751 stores at end Q2FY27.

guidance.statement: We've given overall guidance of 60% CAGR [for quick commerce NOV].

status_history.evidence: Management raised long-term quick-commerce margin guidance from 5-6% to 6% EBIT.

guidance.statement: We're likely to end at the higher end of the range that we had guided earlier, with 6% EBIT margin and close to 6% adjusted EBITDA margin in quick commerce.
We now expect to cross 3,500 stores by March 2027, and our current plans point to about 5,000 stores by March 2028.
We also remain on track towards our earlier guidance of INR 28,000 crore NOV (US$ 3 billion) and INR 1,400 crore (US$ 150 million) Adjusted EBITDA by FY30.
guidance.target: INR 28,000 crore NOV and INR 1,400 crore Adjusted EBITDA

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Consumer Services > Retailing > E-Retail/ E-Commerce

operating_notes.text: In quick commerce, the group transitioned from a marketplace model to a combination of marketplace and inventory-led model in Q1FY26.
Consideration for acquisition of OTPL and WEPL post adjustment amounted to INR 2,014 crore.
Quick-commerce inventory losses are about 1.8% of NOV, largely perishables, and management does not expect material improvement.
Net working capital is at 14 days, with a steady-state estimate of 12 days, down from an earlier 18-day assumption.
Bistro is adding about 10 kitchens a quarter and is in a separate entity with no overlap in NOV or bottom line.
Revenue under quick commerce now includes direct sales to customers on the Blinkit platform following structural changes.
Blinkit had 2,751 stores at end Q2FY27 after 308 net additions in the quarter.
Hyperpure serves about 85,000 restaurants, up from 62,000 a year ago.
Delhi NCR Blinkit assortment grew from about 80,000 SKUs in Q4FY26 to about 100,000.
Going-out India business generated FY26 revenue of ₹587 Cr (5.39% of standalone) and net worth of ₹8 Cr.
ICRA monitoring report confirms ₹6,982.89 Cr of ₹8,436.12 Cr QIP proceeds deployed through Sep 30, 2026; dark store allocation (₹2,137 Cr) fully completed.

timeline.summary: Eternal scheduled board meeting and earnings call for April 28, 2026 to discuss FY26 results.
Eternal approved the transfer of the District platform tech stack and staff to subsidiary WEPL for ₹24.19 Cr.
Eternal Limited reported Q4FY26 consolidated adjusted revenue of ₹17,680 crore and a standalone net profit of ₹705 crore.
Eternal entered into an asset transfer agreement to transfer the District platform technology stack to its wholly owned subsidiary Wasteland Entertainment Private Limited for ₹24.19 crore.
Eternal filed the transcript of its Q4FY26 earnings conference call conducted on April 28, 2026.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹24,138 Cr (+77.6% YoY), net profit ₹125 Cr (+92.3% YoY).
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹24,138 Cr; Blinkit store target raised to 3,500 by March 2027.
Eternal approved the slump sale of its Going-out India business to subsidiary ZEPL for ~₹130.76 Cr and agreed to swap its Adonmo shares for a 4.4% post-merger stake in Mygate valued at ₹156 Cr.
ICRA issued monitoring agency report for Q2FY27 showing ₹629.95 Cr utilized, leaving ₹1,453.23 Cr unutilized with zero deviation.

watchlist.response: EBIT margin is negative, so there is no ROCE today; the framework is for future investment decisions.
Still in stealth mode; will share more in coming quarters; expenses largely manpower.
Long-term expectation is 20%+ annual growth; will not read too much into a single quarter.

watchlist.response: Food delivery and quick commerce are low-risk; District is medium-to-high risk; margins should hold as infrastructure owners capture value.
